from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """A Common Data Set record for a single university."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university/institution")
    total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students enrollment")
    first_time_applicants: int | None = Field(description="First-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")
    transfer_applicants: int | None = Field(description="Transfer applicants")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
